## Trellis: Clip Publish (YouTube Shorts)

Last phase of the Clip Studio pipeline. Downloads the stitched final Short, uploads it to YouTube, then writes the URL back and marks the publication **live**.

**Webhook:** `https://n8n.sproutify.app/webhook/trellis-clip-publish` (= `CLIP_PUBLISH_WEBHOOK` in constants.ts)
**Fired by:** `clipService.publishClip` with `{ publication_id, project_id, branch, platform:'youtube', video_url, metadata:{title,description,tags,hashtags} }`.

### FLOW
Webhook → **Build Metadata** (title / description+hashtags / tags trimmed to YT limits) → **Mark Uploading** → **Download Video** → **YouTube Upload** (category 22 = People & Blogs) → **Mark Live** (publication live + shorts URL) → **Update Project** (status published).

### SETUP (mirrors E4-episode-publish — same credentials)
1. **YouTube Upload node** → set **Credential → the same Google/YouTube OAuth2 account** you connected for Episode publish.
2. **The 3 Supabase nodes** → set **Credential → your Trellis (Hub) Supabase account** (`trellis_clip_publications` / `trellis_clip_projects` live on the Hub).
3. Verify the YouTube node field names after import (they vary by n8n version) — same caveat as E4.

### NOTES
- Vertical video ≤3 minutes is auto-classified as a Short; `#Shorts` is appended to the description as a belt-and-braces signal.
- Same unverified-app caveat as E4: while the Google OAuth app is in Testing, uploads are forced private+locked until verified.
- Add an error branch setting the publication to `failed` if you want upload errors surfaced in the Clip Studio UI.
